extra.message: update_application's status-transition logic has no role/assignment authorization for decision states. Any user permitted to edit (including the owning borrower when status is draft/needs_documents/counteroffered, and underwriters not assigned to the application) can change the status. Because counteroffered->approved is a valid transition, a borrower can self-approve their own loan once documents are accepted, and an unassigned underwriter can approve/reject applications. The dedicated /api/decisions endpoint enforces assignment, but this status-update path does not.
